email_body:
Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am writing to apply for the Warehouse Worker - Night Shift position in Oostkamp. I have warehouse experience from my time at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, where I worked in a fast-paced logistics environment, maintaining accuracy and efficiency. I am comfortable operating an electrical pallet truck and am not afraid of cold environments. I am a night owl and prefer working night shifts.

I already live in Belgium with a valid address and have legal permission to work. I have my own transportation to Oostkamp.

I am eager to join your team and contribute to the distribution of frozen food products. I am a quick learner and motivated to grow within the company, including pursuing reach truck training.

Please find my CV attached. I am available for an interview at your convenience.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am excited to apply for the Warehouse Worker - Night Shift position at your leading logistics company in Oostkamp. With my recent warehouse experience at Katoen Natie in Antwerp and my strong work ethic, I am confident I can contribute effectively to your team.

During my time at Katoen Natie, I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment. I am comfortable operating an electrical pallet truck and have experience with loading and unloading, quality checks, and keeping the warehouse organized. I am not afraid of working in cold environments and am fully committed to night shifts, as I am naturally a night owl.

I already live in Belgium with a valid address and have legal permission to work. I have my own transportation to Oostkamp, so I can start immediately.

What attracts me to this role is the stable, English-speaking environment and the opportunity for long-term growth. I am eager to receive internal training, including reach truck training, and to develop my skills further. I am a quick learner and take pride in doing my job well.

I am enthusiastic about joining your team and contributing to the efficient distribution of frozen food products. I am available for an interview at your earliest convenience and can start as soon as possible.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of working with you.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
